notes: *that* is the connective the ASV writes for the waw of a clause it has recast as subordinate (rules 14, 55); *none* is the negative's, being the word the clause's negation has become when recast onto the subject nominal (rule 15), while טָמֵא keeps *that was unclean* with its supplied relative and copula.

כָל־דָּבָר fuses to *anything* under rule 30, headed on the governing כֹּל (rule 23); the competing division would give *any* to כֹּל and *thing* to דָּבָר, but the ASV writes one word and neither morpheme owns a part of it.
